targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, watts AS value, device_name AS metric FROM telemetry.energy WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%' ORDER BY ts
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w),0) AS "Total W" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) watts AS w FROM telemetry.energy WHERE ts > now()-interval '10 min' ORDER BY device_name, ts DESC) s

SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_name) device_name AS "Plug", watts AS "Watts", volts AS "Volts", amps AS "Amps", on_state AS "On", ts AS "Last seen" FROM telemetry.energy WHERE ts > now()-interval '1 hour' ORDER BY device_name, ts DESC

panels.description: Combined instantaneous power across all named smart plugs (sum of per-plug avg per minute).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS "time", SUM(w) AS "Total W" FROM ( SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1m') AS t, device_name, avg(watts) AS w FROM telemetry.energy WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%' GROUP BY 1, device_name) s GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Total power — all plugs (W)

panels.description: Projected monthly cost if current plug draw held all month, on BWP residential tiers (Tier1 ≤300 kWh/mo @ $0.18, Tier2 @ $0.2782, all-in incl ECAC, 2024 schedule — a ~9.9% 2026 increase applies). Plugs are marginal load so most falls in Tier 2.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS "time", round((LEAST(kwh,300)*0.18 + GREATEST(kwh-300,0)*0.2782)::numeric,2) AS "Proj $/mo (tiered)" FROM (SELECT t, (SUM(w)/1000.0)*730 AS kwh FROM (   SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,'1m') AS t, device_name, avg(watts) AS w   FROM telemetry.energy WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device_name NOT LIKE '0x%'   GROUP BY 1, device_name) p GROUP BY t) m ORDER BY t

panels.title: Projected monthly cost — BWP tiered ($0.18 ≤300kWh / $0.2782 above)

panels.description: The server rack / office plugs (office_plug + office_plug_2), 7-day average draw, priced at Burbank Water & Power top tier ($0.2782/kWh) because the house is always above the 300 kWh base tier, so every rack kWh is a marginal one. Added 2026-10-01 at Jordan request.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((SUM(w)*730/1000*0.2782)::numeric,0) AS "Rack $/mo"
FROM (SELECT device_name, avg(watts) AS w FROM telemetry.energy
      WHERE ts > now()-interval '7 days' AND device_name IN ('office_plug','office_plug_2') GROUP BY device_name) s

panels.title: Rack cost — $/mo (7-day avg, marginal tier)

panels.description: Hourly average rack draw expressed as a monthly bill at the marginal BWP tier.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS "time", round((SUM(w)*730/1000*0.2782)::numeric,2) AS "Rack $/mo"
FROM (SELECT $__timeGroup(ts,1h) AS t, device_name, avg(watts) AS w FROM telemetry.energy
      WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device_name IN ('office_plug','office_plug_2') GROUP BY 1,2) s GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Rack cost trend — $/mo equivalent
